Realizing how neglected his children are, John Ashdown reflects mournfully on his duties as a father and his unresolved love for Clementine Ainslie before returning to his theological studies.

label: v5 · CHAPTER XXIV. A CHARITABLE IMPULSE
value: Grace gives her only good shoes and stockings to Zilla Marsh.
chapter: v5 · CHAPTER XXIV. A CHARITABLE IMPULSE
unit: In an impulse of charity, Grace gives her only good shoes and stockings to barefoot Zilla Marsh, who quickly leaves to preserve her new possessions. Realizing she will now have to wear her hated striped stockings to church, Grace stands barefoot in a snowbank to catch a cold so she can legitimately stay home. Ida and Tobias pull Grace off the ice after a loud struggle that onlookers misinterpret as a fight, though Grace wakes up healthy the next morning still determined not to wear the stockings.

label: v5 · CHAPTER XXVIII. A FAST DAY
value: The Good-Conduct Club decides to fast on Sunday.
chapter: v5 · CHAPTER XXVIII. A FAST DAY
unit: The Good-Conduct Club decides to fast on Sunday as punishment for their graveyard song, which causes Ida Ashdown to faint during the church service. Doctor Hugh Carrow and Mrs. Elder Clow help revive her, leading Grace to explain their self-punishment rule to their distraught father. Realizing how neglected his children are, John Ashdown reflects mournfully on his duties as a father and his unresolved love for Clementine Ainslie before returning to his theological studies.

unit: In the attic at Grey Shutters, Nell Harcourt and Isolde Duckett chat about Nell's upcoming marriage to Hugh Carrow and her move to Seven Gulls Harbor. They reflect on their past, Isolde's young daughter Small Nell Lucinda, and the local gossips of Brierley.

label: v4 · CHAPTER 17 A SEVEN GULLS WINTER
value: During a cold winter at Seven Gulls, Nell spends time with Lorna.
chapter: v4 · CHAPTER 17 A SEVEN GULLS WINTER
unit: During a cold winter at Seven Gulls, Nell spends time with Lorna and Captain Saul, though she senses an underlying distance and resentment from Lorna despite their friendship. After Lorna reacts bitterly to news of Nell's upcoming child, she later gifts Nell a delicately handmade baby gown. Meanwhile, Captain Saul shares his written life log with Nell, who wishes a talented writer like Cedric could turn his adventurous life into a book.

unit: In class, Hugh Carrow teases Nell about her red hair, prompting her to smash her slate over his head in anger. Upon returning home, Thirza Abernethy seeks advice from Agatha Sowerby, who recommends letting Nell rest at home until her temper subsides.

value: Thirza attends a political rally in town.
chapter: v1 · CHAPTER XVIII. Nell to the Rescue
unit: While Thirza and Mrs. Sowerby attend a political rally in town, Nell and Obed spend a quiet evening at Grey Shutters. Isolde Pembroke rushes in to ask for help when her baby sister, Posy Fay, contracts croup while their parents are away. Nell uses her experience to treat Posy Fay through the night until a doctor arrives, saving the child's life before returning home to rest.

chapter: v2 · II Selling in Haste and Repenting at Leisure
unit: On their way back from shopping in Delford, Nell and Isolde chase a Jersey cow out of a neighbor's oat field, and Nell impulsively sells the cow to Mr. Shearer. Upon returning home to Grey Shutters, Nell discovers her own cow is still in the pen, realizing she mistakenly sold Mr. Pettifer's cow instead. Resigned to face his temper, Nell packs a freshly baked nut cake as a peace offering and sets off to confess her mistake to Mr. Pettifer.

Resigned to face his temper, Nell packs a freshly baked nut cake as a peace offering and sets off to confess her mistake to Mr. Pettifer.

chapter: v1 · CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot
unit: In class, Hugh Carrow teases Nell about her red hair, prompting her to smash her slate over his head in anger. Mr. Pidgeon punishes Nell by forcing her to stand at the front of the room and later making her sit beside Hugh, leading Nell to declare that she will never return to school. Upon returning home, Thirza Abernethy seeks advice from Agatha Sowerby, who recommends letting Nell rest at home until her temper subsides.

value: Thirza attends a political rally in town
chapter: v1 · CHAPTER XVIII. Nell to the Rescue
unit: While Thirza and Mrs. Sowerby attend a political rally in town, Nell and Obed spend a quiet evening at Grey Shutters. Isolde Pembroke rushes in to ask for help when her baby sister, Posy Fay, contracts croup while their parents are away. Nell uses her experience to treat Posy Fay through the night until a doctor arrives, saving the child's life before returning home to rest.

chapter: v1 · CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot
unit: In class, Hugh Carrow teases Nell about her red hair, prompting her to smash her slate over his head in anger. Mr. Pidgeon punishes Nell by forcing her to stand at the front of the room and later making her sit beside Hugh, leading Nell to declare that she will never return to school. Upon returning home, Thirza Abernethy seeks advice from Agatha Sowerby, who recommends letting Nell rest at home until her temper subsides.

label: v1 · CHAPTER XVIII. Nell to the Rescue
value: Thirza attends a political rally in town
chapter: v1 · CHAPTER XVIII. Nell to the Rescue
unit: While Thirza and Mrs. Sowerby attend a political rally in town, Nell and Obed spend a quiet evening at Grey Shutters. Isolde Pembroke rushes in to ask for help when her baby sister, Posy Fay, contracts croup while their parents are away. Nell uses her experience to treat Posy Fay through the night until a doctor arrives, saving the child's life before returning home to rest.

She later discusses the church's new leadership, her Sunday school experiences, and her excitement about baking a cake for the new minister's visit, which she practices for while spending time with Isolde by the Nymph's Well.

label: v1 · CHAPTER XXIII. Nell Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor
value: Isolde Pembroke hosts a party.
chapter: v1 · CHAPTER XXIII. Nell Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor
unit: At a party hosted by Isolde Pembroke, Nell Harcourt accepts a dare from Flossie Tulk to walk across the kitchen roof's ridgepole. She slips and falls, breaking her ankle in the process. Mr. Pembroke carries her home to Thirza Abernethy, and Nell spends the next seven weeks recovering in bed while friends, neighbors, and local figures visit her.

unit: In bed on New Year's Eve, Odette proposes marriage to Nell on behalf of her bashful brother, Barney. unit: Nell wakes up at Grey Shutters and marvels at the bright June morning outside her window, though she laments that her stay will likely be brief. Mr. Pidgeon punishes Nell by forcing her to stand at the front of the room and later making her sit beside Hugh, leading Nell to declare that she will never return to school. Upon returning home, Thirza Abernethy seeks advice from Agatha Sowerby, who recommends letting Nell rest at home until her temper subsides.

chapter: v1 · CHAPTER XVIII. Nell to the Rescue
unit: While Thirza and Mrs. Sowerby attend a political rally in town, Nell and Obed spend a quiet evening at Grey Shutters. Isolde Pembroke rushes in to ask for help when her baby sister, Posy Fay, contracts croup while their parents are away. Nell uses her experience to treat Posy Fay through the night until a doctor arrives, saving the child's life before returning home to rest.

unit: At a party hosted by Isolde Pembroke, Nell Harcourt accepts a dare from Flossie Tulk to walk across the kitchen roof's ridgepole. She slips and falls, breaking her ankle in the process. chapter: v1 · CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed
unit: Following the excitement of the school concert, routine resumes at Brierley while Nell and Isolde discuss turning thirteen and working on school essays along the Aspen Path. Nell shares a dramatic story she wrote for Miss Thorne's assignment, inspiring the creation of a private story club with Isolde and other girls. When Nell discusses the club's creative endeavors with Thirza, Thirza dismisses the story writing as foolish and harmful to her studies.

label: v1 · CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid
value: Nell acts out the story of Elaine.
chapter: v1 · CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid
unit: Nell and her friends act out the story of Elaine, with Nell drifting down the pond in a flat-bottomed boat. The boat begins leaking and sinks, forcing Nell to cling to a bridge pile until Hugh Carrow rescues her in his dory. Afterward, Hugh asks for Nell's friendship, but she stubbornly refuses him before reuniting with her frightened friends.

When confronted about his trickery and lying, Robin breaks down in tears, admitting he didn't realize lying was wrong, leading Nell and Thirza to forgive the lies while determining how to discipline him for locking Lucy away.

unit: Nell and Mr. Pettifer debate Mrs. Sowerby's character and discuss the Improvement Society's progress on fixing up the hall. label: v2 · X Robin in Search of a Sensation
value: Nell walks home through the woods.
chapter: v2 · X Robin in Search of a Sensation
unit: Nell walks home through the woods, chatting with Isolde Pembroke along the way. Upon arriving at Grey Shutters, she learns from Thirza Abernethy that young Lucy has gone missing, sparking a desperate search that eventually leads to finding Lucy locked in Mr. Pettifer's toolhouse by Robin Farrow. When confronted about his trickery and lying, Robin breaks down in tears, admitting he didn't realize lying was wrong, leading Nell and Thirza to forgive the lies while determining how to discipline him for locking Lucy away.

chapter: v2 · IX A Question of Color
unit: Nell and Mr. Pettifer debate Mrs. Sowerby's character and discuss the Improvement Society's progress on fixing up the hall. Later, Mrs. Sowerby and the youths discover that Joshua Tulk painted the hall bright blue instead of green due to a mix-up with paint order numbers. Despite the catastrophic outcome, the community rallies behind the Improvers and blames the Tulks for the mistake.

label: v2 · X Robin in Search of a Sensation
value: Nell walks home through the woods.
chapter: v2 · X Robin in Search of a Sensation
unit: Nell walks home through the woods, chatting with Isolde Pembroke along the way. Upon arriving at Grey Shutters, she learns from Thirza Abernethy that young Lucy has gone missing, sparking a desperate search that eventually leads to finding Lucy locked in Mr. Pettifer's toolhouse by Robin Farrow. When confronted about his trickery and lying, Robin breaks down in tears, admitting he didn't realize lying was wrong, leading Nell and Thirza to forgive the lies while determining how to discipline him for locking Lucy away.

chapter: v1 · CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot
unit: In class, Hugh Carrow teases Nell about her red hair, prompting her to smash her slate over his head in anger. Upon returning home, Thirza Abernethy seeks advice from Agatha Sowerby, who recommends letting Nell rest at home until her temper subsides.

value: Thirza attends a political rally in town
chapter: v1 · CHAPTER XVIII. Nell to the Rescue
unit: While Thirza and Mrs. Sowerby attend a political rally in town, Nell and Obed spend a quiet evening at Grey Shutters. Isolde Pembroke rushes in to ask for help when her baby sister, Posy Fay, contracts croup while their parents are away. Nell uses her experience to treat Posy Fay through the night until a doctor arrives, saving the child's life before returning home to rest.

value: Isolde Pembroke hosts a party.
chapter: v1 · CHAPTER XXIII. Nell Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor
unit: At a party hosted by Isolde Pembroke, Nell Harcourt accepts a dare from Flossie Tulk to walk across the kitchen roof's ridgepole. She slips and falls, breaking her ankle in the process. Mr. Pembroke carries her home to Thirza Abernethy, and Nell spends the next seven weeks recovering in bed while friends, neighbors, and local figures visit her.

value: Nell walks home through the woods.
chapter: v2 · X Robin in Search of a Sensation
unit: Nell walks home through the woods, chatting with Isolde Pembroke along the way. Upon arriving at Grey Shutters, she learns from Thirza Abernethy that young Lucy has gone missing, sparking a desperate search that eventually leads to finding Lucy locked in Mr. Pettifer's toolhouse by Robin Farrow. When confronted about his trickery and lying, Robin breaks down in tears, admitting he didn't realize lying was wrong, leading Nell and Thirza to forgive the lies while determining how to discipline him for locking Lucy away.

value: Nell walks home through the woods.
chapter: v2 · X Robin in Search of a Sensation
unit: Nell walks home through the woods, chatting with Isolde Pembroke along the way. Upon arriving at Grey Shutters, she learns from Thirza Abernethy that young Lucy has gone missing, sparking a desperate search that eventually leads to finding Lucy locked in Mr. Pettifer's toolhouse by Robin Farrow. When confronted about his trickery and lying, Robin breaks down in tears, admitting he didn't realize lying was wrong, leading Nell and Thirza to forgive the lies while determining how to discipline him for locking Lucy away.

Upon returning home, Thirza Abernethy seeks advice from Agatha Sowerby, who recommends letting Nell rest at home until her temper subsides.

label: v2 · X Robin in Search of a Sensation
value: Nell walks home through the woods.
chapter: v2 · X Robin in Search of a Sensation
unit: Nell walks home through the woods, chatting with Isolde Pembroke along the way. Upon arriving at Grey Shutters, she learns from Thirza Abernethy that young Lucy has gone missing, sparking a desperate search that eventually leads to finding Lucy locked in Mr. Pettifer's toolhouse by Robin Farrow. When confronted about his trickery and lying, Robin breaks down in tears, admitting he didn't realize lying was wrong, leading Nell and Thirza to forgive the lies while determining how to discipline him for locking Lucy away.

label: v1 · CHAPTER IV. Morning at Grey Shutters
value: Nell wakes up at Grey Shutters.
chapter: v1 · CHAPTER IV. Morning at Grey Shutters
unit: Nell wakes up at Grey Shutters and marvels at the bright June morning outside her window, though she laments that her stay will likely be brief. During breakfast and while helping with household chores, she talks incessantly to a sharp yet increasingly fascinated Thirza, even bestowing names like Frost Maiden on the cherry tree and Bonny on the geranium. Afterwards, Thirza takes Nell in the buggy to Pale Sands to meet Mrs. Tranter and settle Nell's return to Nova Scotia, despite Obed's quiet desire to keep the girl.

During breakfast and while helping with household chores, she talks incessantly to a sharp yet increasingly fascinated Thirza, even bestowing names like Frost Maiden on the cherry tree and Bonny on the geranium. Afterwards, Thirza takes Nell in the buggy to Pale Sands to meet Mrs. Tranter and settle Nell's return to Nova Scotia, despite Obed's quiet desire to keep the girl.

value: Thirza presents Nell with three simple dresses.
chapter: CHAPTER XI. Nell’s Impressions of Sunday-school
unit: Thirza presents Nell with three simple dresses and refuses her request for fashionable puffed sleeves, sending her off to study Sunday school materials. The next morning, Nell decorates her hat with flowers and attends Sunday school alone when Thirza falls ill. label: CHAPTER XX. A Good Imagination Gone Wrong
value: Nell is in her room at Grey Shutters.
chapter: CHAPTER XX. A Good Imagination Gone Wrong
unit: In her room at Grey Shutters, Nell reflects on her first year with Thirza, who admits she does not regret keeping her. When Thirza asks her to fetch an apron pattern from the Pembrokes, Nell confesses that she and Isolde invented ghosts in the nearby wood, making her terrified to cross it in the dark. Unmoved, Thirza forces Nell to walk through the woods to teach her a lesson, and Nell reluctantly completes the frightening errand.

Resigned to face his temper, Nell packs a freshly baked nut cake as a peace offering and sets off to confess her mistake to Mr. Pettifer.

value: Nell spends the morning preparing Grey Shutters.

unit: Nell and Isolde spend the morning busily preparing Grey Shutters and cooking a lavish meal to welcome Mrs. Varley, but Robin accidentally ruins the lemon pies and gets sent to his room. When Mrs. Varley and Honora fail to arrive, the group sits down to eat without them, only to discover the peas have been over-sweetened by multiple cooks. To make matters worse, as dinner ends, Robin accidentally knocks a heavy shell down the stairs, shattering Miss Pembroke's borrowed platter.

unit: Nell writes a story titled 'Evadne's Atonement', sharing her process and drafts with Isolde and seeking feedback from Mr. Pettifer. unit: Nell receives an unexpected and awkward marriage proposal from her neighbor Sam, which she rejects and later laughs about with Thora. label: CHAPTER XXIV. A CHARITABLE IMPULSE
value: Grace gives her only good shoes and stockings to Zilla Marsh.
chapter: CHAPTER XXIV. A CHARITABLE IMPULSE
unit: In an impulse of charity, Grace gives her only good shoes and stockings to barefoot Zilla Marsh, who quickly leaves to preserve her new possessions. unit: The Good-Conduct Club decides to fast on Sunday as punishment for their graveyard song, which causes Ida Ashdown to faint during the church service. value: Grace, Rupert, and Ida are terrified by a white figure crawling in the Bailey garden.
chapter: CHAPTER XXX. THE GHOST ON THE DYKE
unit: Terrified by a white figure crawling in the Bailey garden that they mistake for Henry Warren's ghost, Grace, Rupert, and Ida flee from Fern Hollow to Hollowmere. Clementine Ainslie calms the children while Tabitha goes to investigate with a pitchfork. Tabitha returns with the news that the 'ghost' was merely old Mrs. Stimson crawling around in white sheets searching for a lost knitting needle.

unit: Lionel Fairlie confronts Clementine at Fern Hollow and asks her to release her sister Harriet from a vow so they can marry, which Clementine willingly grants. unit: Mary Stubbs gossip-shares village rumors with Grace and Ida about why Clementine refused their father's proposal and how Rupert threw an eel into Mrs. Carr's buggy.
